title: Ragefire Chasm
body: Ragefire Chasm is a network of volcanic caverns beneath Orgrimmar, entered from the Cleft of Shadow in the heart of the city. Lava lights its tunnels and molten elementals walk the burning paths. Troggs have come up from deep below and swarm the lower caves under their chieftain Oggleflint, and beyond them the halls belong to the Searing Blade, a cult of orc warlocks and enforcers with a demon among them.

parts.body: Magatha Grimtotem sought peace with the troggs, but they killed her diplomats. One of her servants, Maur, found something in the chasm and never came out with it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ragefire_Chasm_(Classic), official description (a network of volcanic caverns below the orcs' capital of Orgrimmar); entrance in the Cleft of Shadow beside Neeru Fireblade's tent; route: elementals, troggs, more elementals, then the Searing Blade; Taragaman in the middle of a lava lake, Jergosh ahead of him, Bazzalan up a side walkway directly above Jergosh; classic Oggleflint in his own cave off the main path (moved only in 4.0.3a)

parts.body: The Searing Blade keeps two books of spells, gifts of the Legion to its followers, and the Undercity wants them out of the cult's hands and in its own.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ragefire_Chasm_(Classic), official description (a network of volcanic caverns below the orcs' capital of Orgrimmar); entrance in the Cleft of Shadow beside Neeru Fireblade's tent; route: elementals, troggs, more elementals, then the Searing Blade; Taragaman in the middle of a lava lake, Jergosh ahead of him, Bazzalan up a side walkway directly above Jergosh; classic Oggleflint in his own cave off the main path (moved only in 4.0.3a)

parts.body: The Searing Blade is Neeru Fireblade's own sect of the Shadow Council. Thrall had its leaders, the satyr Bazzalan and the warlock Jergosh, killed without Neeru learning who did it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Ragefire_Chasm_(Classic), official description (a network of volcanic caverns below the orcs' capital of Orgrimmar); entrance in the Cleft of Shadow beside Neeru Fireblade's tent; route: elementals, troggs, more elementals, then the Searing Blade; Taragaman in the middle of a lava lake, Jergosh ahead of him, Bazzalan up a side walkway directly above Jergosh; classic Oggleflint in his own cave off the main path (moved only in 4.0.3a)

title: Taragaman the Hungerer
body: Taragaman the Hungerer is a felguard, a demon of the Burning Legion, who stands in the midst of a lake of lava in the Searing Blade's halls. Neeru Fireblade names him the cult's leader. The Warchief charged Neeru with rooting out whatever brings demonic taint into the city, and Neeru sends those he trusts down into the chasm to kill him.

parts.body: Neeru took the felguard's heart into his own keeping, promising it would be dealt with as it should be, and went to carry word of the victory to Thrall himself.
